_meta.description: Other regions shown on the map in grey: established combined authorities, emerging strategic authorities, and deal areas and joint committees in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. They are not priority regions and carry no scheme records. Boundaries are built from member councils (ONS LAD December 2025). An entry with "cauth" is matched to the ONS combined authority of that name and its "lads" list is filled in by the boundary build. Not exhaustive.

regions.name: Surrey
regions.type: County reorganising into two unitary councils
regions.status_note: Not on the Devolution Priority Programme. The Secretary of State decided, subject to Parliamentary approval, to replace the county and its 11 districts with two unitary councils.
regions.unknowns: Start date of the new councils, and the plan and timetable for a strategic authority covering Surrey, were not confirmed from the page read. The boundary shown is the current county.

sources.title: GOV.UK: Local government reorganisation in Surrey
